tools.name: chat
tools.description: Chat completion (small open models) ($0.002 per call, paid via MPP on Tempo). OpenAI-style chat with open-weight models on Cloudflare Workers AI: gemma-4-26b-a4b (default), granite-4-micro (fastest), gpt-oss-20b (all Apache-2.0). Send messages[] or a prompt; up to ~6k input tokens and 1,024 output t

tools.name: translate
tools.description: Translate text (100 languages) ($0.003 per call, paid via MPP on Tempo). Machine translation between 100 languages (Meta M2M-100 1.2B, MIT licence): one text up to 5,000 characters or up to 20 texts per call, source and target as ISO codes or names. Long text is split by sentence and reassembled. HT

tools.name: embeddings
tools.description: Text embeddings (multilingual) ($0.0005 per call, paid via MPP on Tempo). Dense vector embeddings for up to 100 texts per call (BAAI bge-m3, 1024 dimensions, 100+ languages, MIT licence), L2-normalised for cosine similarity. OpenAI-style response (data[i].embedding). HTTP POST https://mpp-ai.fmf-x40

tools.name: rerank
tools.description: Rerank documents for a query ($0.001 per call, paid via MPP on Tempo). Score and sort up to 100 documents by relevance to a query with a cross-encoder (BAAI bge-reranker-base, MIT licence). Returns index, relevance score (0-1) and text, best first; top_n to truncate. Ideal after search or embeddings

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: chat, rerank · Private data: chat, rerank · Public sink: chat, translate, embeddings, rerank · Destructive: rerank.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: chat, rerank · Private data: chat, rerank · Public sink: chat, translate, embeddings, rerank · Destructive: rerank

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
